description_good_justification: The README says what trlctl does and the problem it solves: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/README.md#description
interact_justification: Installation is in the README; bug reports, enhancements and contributions go through GitHub issues and pull requests, as CONTRIBUTING.md says. https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/README.md#installation https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: Contributions are pull requests on GitHub; the process is in https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#submitting-a-change
contribution_requirements_justification: A change keeps the pre-commit hooks and the tests green, comes with its tests and docs, and follows the commit style: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_basics_justification: Installation, configuration and usage are in https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/README.md
documentation_interface_justification: Every flag and environment variable, the human and JSON output formats and the exit statuses are documented in https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/README.md#configuration and https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/README.md#usage
sites_https_justification: The repository, the releases, crates.io and the Homebrew tap are only served over HTTPS. https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/releases
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone with a GitHub account, no proprietary client needed. https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/issues
english_justification: Documentation, issues and code review are in English: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/README.md
repo_track_justification: Git records each change, its author and its date: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: main holds every change made between releases, merged from pull requests, not only the release commits: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/commits/main
repo_distributed_justification: The repository is a Git repository hosted on GitHub.
version_unique_justification: Each release has its own version, set in Cargo.toml and tagged by the release script, which refuses an existing tag: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/scripts/release.sh
version_tags_justification: Each release is an annotated git tag vX.Y.Z created by the release script, and the release workflow checks the tag against Cargo.toml: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/scripts/release.sh
release_notes_justification: Each GitHub release carries notes built from the titles of the pull requests it contains, sorted by label into the categories of https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.github/release.yaml (breaking changes, security, features, fixes...), not a git log. https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: No vulnerability in trlctl has been publicly disclosed, and a fix would land under the Security category of the release notes: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/security/advisories https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.github/release.yaml
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported as GitHub issues: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_archive_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public and searchable: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Vulnerabilities are reported through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting, which opens a draft advisory only the maintainers and the reporter see: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: cargo build --release --locked, run as task build and by the build workflow for every release target: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/Taskfile.yml https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.github/workflows/build.yaml
build_floss_tools_justification: The Rust toolchain and Cargo, pinned in mise.toml, are FLOSS: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/mise.toml
test_justification: Unit tests in src/ and integration tests in tests/, under the MIT licence, run with task test as CONTRIBUTING.md documents: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/tree/main/tests https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#running-the-tests
test_invocation_justification: cargo test, wrapped by task test: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/Taskfile.yml
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The tests run on every pull request and every push to main, and are required to merge: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yaml
test_policy_justification: A new rule comes with a test that breaks it in the fixture; a fix comes with a test that reproduces the bug: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#running-the-tests
tests_are_added_justification: The latest functional changes added their tests: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/pull/7 https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/pull/5 https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/pull/1
warnings_justification: Clippy with the all and pedantic groups, run with -D warnings by pre-commit; unsafe code is forbidden: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/Cargo.toml https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
warnings_fixed_justification: Clippy runs with -D warnings in the quality gate required to merge, so a warning fails the pull request: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yaml
warnings_strict_justification: Clippy's pedantic group is enabled and warnings are denied: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/Cargo.toml
crypto_published_justification: trlctl uses no cryptography: it reads and writes local files offline, with no network access. https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/Cargo.toml
crypto_random_justification: trlctl generates no key or nonce: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/Cargo.toml
delivery_mitm_justification: Releases are delivered over HTTPS from GitHub releases, crates.io and the Homebrew tap, with a Sigstore build provenance attestation: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/README.md#installation
delivery_unsigned_justification: Checksums are served over HTTPS next to the archives, the archives carry a Sigstore provenance attestation, and the Homebrew formula embeds the checksums: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yaml
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The detect-private-key hook runs on every change, GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and the release workflow holds no long-lived token: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#credentials
static_analysis_justification: Clippy, actionlint, zizmor and shellcheck run in the quality gate required to merge, and GitHub CodeQL analyses the Rust code and the workflows: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security queries for Rust and GitHub Actions, and zizmor's workflow security audits: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
static_analysis_often_justification: The static analysis runs on every pull request and every push to main: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yaml
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: trlctl is written in Rust, a memory-safe language, with unsafe code forbidden: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/Cargo.toml
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The test suite runs in Cargo's test profile, with debug assertions and overflow checks enabled: https://github.com/therealm-tech/trlctl/blob/main/Taskfile.yml
